label: Zimmermann 1778 links measured climatic intensity to graded human variation while keeping the causal reconstruction modal
subject: agent.eberhard-august-wilhelm-von-zimmermann
object: human bodily variation under climate and nourishment

sources.citation: Eberhard August Wilhelm von Zimmermann, Geographische Geschichte des Menschen, und der allgemein verbreiteten vierfüssigen Thiere, vol. 1 (Leipzig: Weygand, 1778), primary page images pp.31-34, 53-59, 100-115; ETH-Bibliothek/e-rara record 6943987
User-supplied full-page images of Zimmermann 1778 pp.50-59, 100-115 inspected 2026-08-27

observations.value: pp.31-34 explicitly formulate Grade der Hitze und Kälte and thermometric differences as measurable environmental intensity.
pp.53-54 ask whether one and the same Menschengattung can, through environmental changes, pass into the Gestalten und Ausartungen presently observed.
p.59 selects the größten Varietäten and explicitly refers to mindern oder untern Grade der Ausartungen; production by Klima und Nahrung is marked möglicher Weise.
pp.106-108 use Nüancen, Stufenfolge and a hypothetical temporal rate of increasing Schwärze, making bodily colour a graded, time-sensitive variable in the causal argument.

claim_limit: Do not collapse temperature degree, colour gradation and grades of Ausartung into one technical scale. Zimmermann repeatedly marks historical-causal reconstruction as possible/conjectural rather than mathematically certain.

label: Zimmermann 1778 gives climate classificatory as well as causal jurisdiction in division into human races
subject: agent.eberhard-august-wilhelm-von-zimmermann
object: Abtheilung des Menschen / Zerfällung in verschiedene Racen

sources.citation: Zimmermann 1778, vol. 1, especially pp.108-111 and 114-115; ETH-Bibliothek/e-rara record 6943987
User-supplied full-page images of Zimmermann 1778 pp.108-115 inspected 2026-08-27

observations.value: p.109 says it would better suit the nature of the matter, in the Abtheilung des Menschen or Zerfällung in verschiedene Racen, to pay more attention to Klima.
p.109 immediately says Blumenbach has partly observed this and refers to his four Hauptracen.

visible skin/body colour remains descriptively and comparatively important but is not treated at this locus as a self-sufficient taxonomic essence; its classificatory meaning is mediated through climate/geography and the wider bundle of bodily difference.
pp.114-115 reconstruct common-origin dispersal through migration and climatic transformation into geographically named human forms, but Zimmermann labels the reconstruction an Einfall.

claim_limit: Do not paraphrase the classificatory rule as simple latitude determinism or modern ecological population genetics. Klima is an eighteenth-century physical-geographical causal/classificatory category, and Zimmermann's historical reconstruction remains conjectural.

label: Zimmermann 1778 uses mobile population and variation vocabulary rather than a demonstrated fixed rank hierarchy
subject: agent.eberhard-august-wilhelm-von-zimmermann

observations.value: p.59 explicitly coordinates Abartungen oder Varietäten and contrasts größten Varietäten with mindern oder untern Grade der Ausartungen.
p.100 states that a European family remaining unmixed could likewise produce a Race with imprinted traits; p.105 develops an isolation/endogamy thought experiment producing a wunderbare Menschenrace.
p.101 argues that all Menschengattungen can be derived from one and the same Stamm by a possible simple route while withholding mathematische Gewißheit.
pp.106-107 treat migration and resulting Vermischungen as a major complication for stable division of humankind.

claim_limit: Operational mobility is not proof that all terms are synonymous everywhere. It means the controlled loci do not support projecting Meiners's later explicit Geschlecht/Stamm/Race/Varietät/Spielart hierarchy back onto Zimmermann.

label: Zimmermann-to-Meiners boundary is rank stabilization and inferential regulation, not the first appearance of climate or race classification

observations.value: Zimmermann already measures climatic intensity, models bodily plasticity, grades variation, allows race formation through isolation/endogamy, treats migration/mixture as boundary-changing, gives climate classificatory jurisdiction, and reconstructs common-origin dispersal conjecturally.

Meiners later states a more explicit Geschlecht/Stamm/Race/Varietät/Spielart architecture, rejects colour as sole/principal mark, and by 1790-1793 more explicitly regulates provenance, isolated-body-part inference, acquired Abhärtung and group-attributed Härte.

The strongest difference is increased stabilization of taxonomic rank and explicit regulation of admissible bodily inference, not a simple shift from climate to heredity or from non-taxonomy to taxonomy.

claim_limit: This is a comparative boundary claim, not proof of direct Zimmermann-to-Meiners influence. Direct influence requires citation/contact evidence.
